title: Bolt's Boogie
logline: A shy service robot named Bolt overcomes his social anxiety to find joy and connection on a vibrant rooftop dance floor.
theme: Overcoming shyness, the joy of self-expression, finding connection

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A compact, somewhat clunky service robot with expressive optical sensors, initially very shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant and friendly human party-goer, observant and encouraging.

scenes.title: Observing from the Edge
scenes.summary: Bolt stands at the edge of a lively rooftop party, watching others dance with curiosity but also clear apprehension.
scenes.setting: A bustling rooftop party at dusk, city lights twinkling in the background.

scenes.title: The Party Vibe
scenes.summary: Quick cuts of people laughing, dancing freely, and enjoying the music. Bolt's optical sensors track the movement, a subtle desire to join in.
scenes.setting: The same vibrant rooftop party, music pulsating.

scenes.title: An Encouraging Nod
scenes.summary: Maya notices Bolt, smiles kindly, and gestures for Bolt to join the dance floor. Bolt hesitates, then slowly rolls forward.
scenes.setting: Near the dance floor, amidst the crowd.

scenes.title: Awkward First Steps
scenes.summary: Bolt attempts a few stiff, robotic dance moves, feeling self-conscious. Maya offers a thumbs-up, encouraging Bolt to loosen up.

scenes.title: Finding a Rhythm
scenes.summary: Bolt starts to get the hang of it, finding a simple, repetitive movement that feels good. A small, joyful whirring sound emanates from Bolt.
scenes.setting: The dance floor, Bolt is now moving more fluidly.

scenes.title: Dancing with Joy
scenes.summary: Bolt is now fully immersed, dancing with simple, expressive moves, a glowing smile emoticon on its display. Others around smile and clap.
scenes.setting: The heart of the dance floor, under colorful party lights.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
